messages.text: How Grant is using his experience in Charlton homecoming

metadata.summary: "It's nice to be home," is Karlan Grant's reply when asked how the last few months have been sign he re-joined Charlton in the summer.
metadata.content: Karlan Grant: Charlton forward on returning to the club and facing Norwich on Red, White and Black weekend | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Exclusive Karlan Grant: Charlton forward on returning to the club and facing Norwich on Red, White and Black weekend Karlan Grant has returned to Charlton after seven years away; this weekend celebrates the club's Red, White and Black campaign and the EFL's Together for Racism fixture; watch Charlton vs Norwich live on Sky Sports Football and Main Event from 11.30am; kick-off 12.30pm Charlotte Marsh Senior Football Journalist Thursday 22 October 2026 17:44, UK "It's nice to be home," is Karlan Grant's reply when asked how the last few months have been sign he re-joined Charlton in the summer. The Addicks academy graduate returned after six years at West Brom, where he had turned down a new deal. "It all aligned at the time and hopefully it's still aligned at the end of the season," he added of why he decided to come back to south London. When Grant left The Valley in January 2019 for Huddersfield, it was not well-received by some Charlton fans. But seven years and three clubs later, the 29-year-old is an experienced and established Championship player.
